query:
UPDATE seller_profile_research_runs
         SET status = 'RUNNING'::seller_profile_research_run_status,
             trigger = $2,
             requested_by_user_id = $3,
             requested_at = to_timestamp(($4::double precision) / 1000.0),
             started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()),
             finished_at = NULL,
             error_code = NULL,
             error_message = NULL,
             metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $5::jsonb
         WHERE id = $1
         RETURNING id
